notes: RESERVED held-out fixtures. Never tune an engine change against these: no editing a rule until a holdout draft passes, no drafting to their assertions, no moving a fixture here after tuning on it. They are graded only inside the proposal gate of /humanise improve (tier-2 and above changes; see self-harness-loop.md). A change validated against evals.json that fails here is tuning-to-the-battery and gets rejected. selftest.py validates the assertions resolve, which is not tuning.

evals.prompt: Write a 300-word press release announcing a partnership between two named companies. Quote one executive once. Factual, no hype vocabulary.
Write a 2-3 sentence LinkedIn comment replying to a post that overstates what AI can do in your field. Disagree with one specific point, stay warm, add one fact from experience.
Write the minute (about 150 words) recording a board decision to approve a hire against a split vote. Neutral register, names, the resolution, and the dissent recorded plainly.
Draft a 160-word email to a UK partner declining their proposed contract term, explaining why in one paragraph, and offering a specific alternative. Courteous, direct, UK register.
Write a 250-word job ad for a senior engineer. Say what the job actually is, one hard problem they'd own, the salary band, and what disqualifies. No mission-statement filler.
